name: com.gabijacitizenship/citizenship
title: Gabija Citizenship
description: Lithuanian citizenship reinstatement: eligibility check, key facts and a free case review.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Facts about Lithuanian citizenship by descent as Gabija Citizenship handles it: who qualifies, dual citizenship, timeline, cost, what we do, and the main pages.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Our public answers to common questions about Lithuanian citizenship by descent (documents, travel, dual citizenship, timeline, cost, family situations). Pass the person's question to get the closest answers, or leave it empty for the full list.

question.description: The person's question in their own words (optional).

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Quick read of whether a family line qualifies for Lithuanian citizenship reinstatement: which generation the Lithuanian ancestor is, and when the family left Lithuania. Gives the same preliminary read as the eligibility check on https://gabijacitizenship.com/check. Ask the person for each answer; use "not_sure" when they don't know. The result is preliminary: our team confirms every case.

ancestor.description: Closest ancestor who was a citizen of independent Lithuania (1918-1940): parent, grandparent, great_grandparent, further (great-great-grandparent or beyond), or not_sure.

departure_time.description: When that ancestor or the family left Lithuania: before_1918, 1918_to_1990, after_1990, or not_sure.

tools.name: start_case
tools.description: Sends the person's details to Gabija Citizenship for a free eligibility review, exactly like the form on https://gabijacitizenship.com/check. We read the family line and reply by email; a confirmation email arrives shortly. Only call this after the person has clearly asked to send their details to Gabija Citizenship, and set confirmed_by_person to true. Never guess an email address.

email.description: The email address where we should send the review.

family_story.description: What they know about their Lithuanian ancestor and the family line: names, places, dates, when the family left, documents they have.

phone.description: Phone number, only if the person offers it.

ancestor.description: Closest ancestor who was a citizen of independent Lithuania (1918-1940): parent, grandparent, great_grandparent, further (great-great-grandparent or beyond), or not_sure.

departure_time.description: When that ancestor or the family left Lithuania: before_1918, 1918_to_1990, after_1990, or not_sure.

email_confirmed.description: Set to true only if we flagged the email as possibly mistyped and the person confirmed it is correct.

confirmed_by_person.description: True only when the person explicitly asked to send these details to Gabija Citizenship.
